minutes.headline: Zoning Board granted three special permits: a common driveway, a house addition and a carport.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard three special permit petitions: a common driveway at 221 Goodrich Street, an addition at 46 Fire Road 12, and a carport at 52 Pearl Street. Each was moved and brought to a vote, and the chair announced the addition granted and the carport approved. The driveway permit was to carry a condition to repave within a year of the new dwelling's completion.

public_comment.topic: An abutter at 53 Pearl Street said the carport would not affect access to his property.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for the common driveway at 221 Goodrich Street, correcting the bylaw section to 6 4 3 B 4, with a repaving condition added.
Grant the special permit for dimensional variation for the addition at 46 Fire Road 12, with architectural plans to be submitted for the record.
Approve the special permit for dimensional variation for the carport at 52 Pearl Street (front and side yard setbacks).

decisions.decision: The driveway permit is to be conditioned on repaving the driveway to the new house within one year after completion of the new dwelling.
The bylaw section cited in the driveway application is corrected to 6 4 3 B 4.
The applicant for the addition is to submit the architectural plans for the record.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for dimensional variation for an addition at 46 Fire Road 12, with architectural plans to be filed for the record.
The board approved a special permit for a carport at 52 Pearl Street, with front and side yard setback relief.
A special permit for a common driveway at 221 Goodrich Street was moved with a repaving condition; the vote result is not audible in the recording.
The driveway permit is to be conditioned on repaving within one year after the new dwelling is completed, and the bylaw section cited was corrected.
An abutter on Pearl Street said the carport would not affect access to his property.

why_it_matters: These permits let owners build closer to lot lines than the zoning bylaw normally allows, which changes what abutters on those streets will see next to them.
The repaving condition on the Goodrich Street driveway sets a written obligation on the new house's owner, tied to the completion of the dwelling.
